stories.title: Arthur and Eliza
stories.note: Family history. Told exactly as written — see verbatim, below.

morpheus: The Scout — a lone soldier on a WWII-era motorcycle on a narrow Normandy road at dawn, hedgerows on both sides, viewed from behind. Muted greens and grays. Painterly, not photorealistic.

The Minefield — a soldier on hands and knees in an open field, a length of wire antenna extended in front of him, a disabled tank in the background. Low angle. Quiet tension. No explosion. Just the work.
The Aid Station — interior of a canvas tent. A nurse with steady hands working on a seated soldier who is watching her. Warm lantern light. Neither of them is looking at the camera.
After — two silhouettes, side by side, looking at something we can't see. Could be any era. Could be anywhere. Together.

amphion.mood: quiet, resolved, neither sad nor triumphant

amphion.note: Should feel like something playing in an empty room where important things happened.
